list_child.name: list_board_batches
list_child.desc: Returns every roast batch on the roastery's production board, from queued green coffee through shipped orders. Use this for a full view of what is moving through the roaster.

decoys.name: list_cupping_batches
decoys.desc: Returns every roast batch on the roastery's cupping schedule, from fresh sample roasts through scored lots. Use this for a full view of what the quality team is tasting.

decoys.name: list_retained_batches
decoys.desc: Returns every roast batch in the roastery's retained sample library, from this week's roasts back through last season. Use this for a full view of what is kept on the shelf for reference.

decoys.name: list_subscription_batches
decoys.desc: Returns every roast batch on the roastery's subscription calendar, from next month's picks back through past boxes. Use this for a full view of what goes out to subscribers.

get_child.name: get_batch_sheet
get_child.desc: Retrieves the batch sheet for a single roast batch by its identifier, including its current phase and ship date. Use this when you already know which batch you need to look at.

decoys.name: get_batch_profile
decoys.desc: Retrieves the roast profile for a single roast batch by its identifier, including its charge temperature and development time. Use this when you already know which batch you need to replicate.

decoys.name: get_batch_scores
decoys.desc: Retrieves the cupping scores for a single roast batch by its identifier, including its aroma and acidity marks. Use this when you already know which batch you need to evaluate.

decoys.name: get_batch_lot
decoys.desc: Retrieves the green lot details for a single roast batch by its identifier, including its importer and harvest year. Use this when you already know which batch you need to trace.

list_parent.name: list_wholesale_clients
list_parent.desc: Returns every client on the roastery's wholesale roster, whether they order weekly or a few times a year. This is the account list the sales team works from.

decoys.name: list_prospect_clients
decoys.desc: Returns every client on the roastery's prospect pipeline, whether they run cafes or buy for grocery shelves. This is the account list the sales team pitches to.

decoys.name: list_subscription_clients
decoys.desc: Returns every client on the roastery's subscription program, whether they receive weekly or monthly boxes. This is the account list the fulfillment team ships to.

decoys.name: list_training_clients
decoys.desc: Returns every client on the roastery's barista training roster, whether they attend weekly or a few times a year. This is the account list the education team teaches.

get_parent.name: get_client_account
get_parent.desc: Retrieves the account profile for a single client by its identifier, pulling up their contact details and order history. Use this when you need information on one specific account.

decoys.name: get_client_pricing
decoys.desc: Retrieves the price sheet for a single client by its identifier, pulling up their per-kilo rates and volume tiers. Use this when you need to quote one specific account.

decoys.name: get_client_equipment
decoys.desc: Retrieves the equipment loan record for a single client by its identifier, pulling up their espresso machines and grinders. Use this when you need to service one specific account.

decoys.name: get_client_standing
decoys.desc: Retrieves the standing order for a single client by its identifier, pulling up their weekly coffees and delivery days. Use this when you need to plan one specific account.

delete_child.name: purge_batch_record
delete_child.desc: Permanently deletes the record of a roast batch from the system, and the deletion is final once it runs. Use this for batches that were logged by mistake or that never went into the roaster.

decoys.name: purge_batch_profile
decoys.desc: Permanently deletes the roast profile of a roast batch from the system, and the deletion is final once it runs. Use this for profiles that were captured from a faulty probe or a botched roast.

decoys.name: purge_batch_scores
decoys.desc: Permanently deletes the cupping scores of a roast batch from the system, and the deletion is final once it runs. Use this for scores that were entered against the wrong batch or session.

decoys.name: purge_batch_labels
decoys.desc: Permanently deletes the bag labels of a roast batch from the system, and the deletion is final once it runs. Use this for labels that were set up with the wrong origin or roast date.

set_enum.name: set_board_phase
set_enum.desc: Sets the board phase of a roast batch, covering queued, roasting, cooling, or shipped. This is how the roastery keeps its production board accurate as green coffee turns into a shipped order.

decoys.name: set_planned_phase
decoys.desc: Sets the planned phase of a roast batch, covering queued, roasting, cooling, or shipped. This is how the head roaster lays out the day's targets before the first charge of the morning.

decoys.name: set_portal_phase
decoys.desc: Sets the portal phase of a roast batch, covering queued, roasting, cooling, or shipped. This is the status wholesale clients see when they check their order tracking page.

decoys.name: set_alert_phase
decoys.desc: Sets the alert phase of a roast batch, covering queued, roasting, cooling, or shipped. This is how the roastery chooses which step sends a notice to the packing crew.

set_bool.name: flag_recall
set_bool.desc: Marks a roast batch as recalled, pulling it out of normal fulfillment. This is used when there is a genuine quality concern with the coffee in the batch.

decoys.name: flag_decaf
decoys.desc: Marks a roast batch as decaf, routing it to the decaf grinder and packing line. This is used when the green lot went through a decaffeination process.

decoys.name: flag_recup
decoys.desc: Marks a roast batch for a recup, sending it back to the cupping table. This is used when a quality grader wants a second tasting of the batch.
verbs: send {obj} back to the cupping table

decoys.name: flag_organic
decoys.desc: Marks a roast batch as certified organic, printing the seal on its bags. This is used when the green lot arrived with valid organic paperwork.

set_ref.name: transfer_batch
set_ref.desc: Transfers a roast batch to a different client, which is useful when an order gets transferred between accounts. The batch keeps its full roast history after the move.

decoys.name: bill_batch
decoys.desc: Bills a roast batch to a different client, which is useful when a cafe group pays for a sister location's order. The charge lands on that client's next wholesale invoice.

decoys.name: sample_batch
decoys.desc: Sends samples of a roast batch to a different client, which is useful when pitching a new origin to another account. The sample shipment is logged against that client.

decoys.name: allocate_batch
decoys.desc: Allocates the leftover bags of a roast batch to a different client, which is useful when another account wants the rest of a lot. The bags are held for that client until pickup.

send.name: email_client
send.desc: Sends an email to the contact on file for a wholesale client. Use this when a batch needs a written update that the client can keep for their records.

decoys.name: call_client
decoys.desc: Places a phone call to the contact on file for a wholesale client. Use this when a batch needs a spoken update that the client can act on right away.

decoys.name: invoice_client
decoys.desc: Sends an invoice to the billing contact on file for a wholesale client. Use this when a batch has shipped and the client needs to be charged for the coffee.

decoys.name: survey_client
decoys.desc: Sends a tasting survey to the contact on file for a wholesale client. Use this when a batch has landed and the roastery wants the client's notes on the cup.
child_verbs: ask the client behind {obj} for tasting feedback

create.name: create_roast_batch
create.desc: Creates a new roast batch for a wholesale client, with an optional origin and starting phase. This is how a fresh order gets onto the roastery's production board.

decoys.name: create_sample_roast
decoys.desc: Creates a new sample roast for a wholesale client, with an optional origin and starting phase. This is how a prospective green lot gets tested before the roastery buys it.

decoys.name: create_cupping_session
decoys.desc: Creates a new cupping session for a wholesale client, with an optional origin and starting phase. This is how a tasting with the client's buyers gets onto the calendar.

decoys.name: create_standing_order
decoys.desc: Creates a new standing order for a wholesale client, with an optional origin and starting phase. This is how a repeating weekly delivery gets set up for the account.

list_notes.name: list_batch_notes
list_notes.desc: Returns the notes attached to a single roast batch. It includes everything the roasting and packing crews have logged against it.

decoys.name: list_batch_readings
decoys.desc: Returns the temperature readings attached to a single roast batch. It includes every probe value the roaster logged against it.

decoys.name: list_batch_cuppings
decoys.desc: Returns the cupping sheets attached to a single roast batch. It includes every score the quality team has logged against it.

decoys.name: list_batch_shipments
decoys.desc: Returns the shipments attached to a single roast batch. It includes every delivery the packing crew has logged against it.

add_note.name: add_batch_note
add_note.desc: Attaches a new note to a roast batch, with an optional title. This is how the roasting and packing crews record observations about a batch.

decoys.name: add_batch_defect
decoys.desc: Attaches a new defect report to a roast batch, with an optional title. This is how the quality team records scorching, tipping or quakers found in a batch.

decoys.name: add_batch_tasting
decoys.desc: Attaches a new tasting sheet to a roast batch, with an optional title. This is how the quality team records aroma, body and finish for a batch.

decoys.name: add_batch_complaint
decoys.desc: Attaches a new client complaint to a roast batch, with an optional title. This is how the sales team records a problem a client raised about a batch.

update_note.name: edit_batch_note
update_note.desc: Changes the text of an existing note on a roast batch, and optionally its title. This is how a crew member corrects or expands a note after logging it.

decoys.name: edit_batch_defect
decoys.desc: Changes the text of an existing defect report on a roast batch, and optionally its title. This is how the quality team revises a finding after a second look.

decoys.name: edit_batch_tasting
decoys.desc: Changes the text of an existing tasting sheet on a roast batch, and optionally its title. This is how a cupper corrects a score after the session.

decoys.name: edit_batch_complaint
decoys.desc: Changes the text of an existing client complaint on a roast batch, and optionally its title. This is how the sales team updates a problem as it gets resolved.

delete_note.name: delete_batch_note
delete_note.desc: Permanently removes a note from a roast batch. The note is erased from the batch history for good.

decoys.name: delete_batch_defect
decoys.desc: Permanently removes a defect report from a roast batch. The finding is erased from the quality log for good.

decoys.name: delete_batch_tasting
decoys.desc: Permanently removes a tasting sheet from a roast batch. The scores are erased from the cupping log for good.

decoys.name: delete_batch_complaint
decoys.desc: Permanently removes a client complaint from a roast batch. The complaint is erased from the account history for good.

set_image.name: set_batch_photo
set_image.desc: Sets the photo shown on a roast batch record. It is usually a shot of the finished beans taken at the cooling tray.

decoys.name: set_batch_artwork
decoys.desc: Sets the bag artwork on a roast batch record. It is usually the label design printed on the retail bags.

decoys.name: set_batch_curve
decoys.desc: Sets the roast curve screenshot on a roast batch record. It is usually the profile graph exported from the roasting software.

decoys.name: set_batch_greens
decoys.desc: Sets the green coffee photo on a roast batch record. It is usually a shot of the raw beans taken when the lot arrived.

writer.name: write_message
writer.desc: Writes a short message from a brief, which states what to say in the requester's own words, and the roast batches it should mention. It returns the finished text.

decoys.name: write_newsletter
decoys.desc: Writes a short client newsletter from a brief, which states what to cover in the requester's own words, and the roast batches it should mention. It returns the finished text.

decoys.name: write_menu
decoys.desc: Writes a short cafe menu card from a brief, which states what to list in the requester's own words, and the roast batches it should mention. It returns the finished text.

decoys.name: write_story
decoys.desc: Writes a short origin story from a brief, which states what to tell in the requester's own words, and the roast batches it should mention. It returns the finished text.

image.name: generate_illustration
image.desc: Generates an illustration from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the result.

decoys.name: generate_label
decoys.desc: Generates a bag label design from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the design.

decoys.name: generate_poster
decoys.desc: Generates a cafe menu poster from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the poster.

decoys.name: generate_map
decoys.desc: Generates an origin map from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the map.

search.name: search_help
search.desc: Searches the help docs and FAQ with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to look up how the roastery's software works.

decoys.name: search_lots
decoys.desc: Searches the importers' green lot sheets with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to look up a coffee's farm and processing details.

decoys.name: search_manual
decoys.desc: Searches the roaster's equipment docs and service manual with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to look up how to service the machine.

decoys.name: search_standards
decoys.desc: Searches the cupping protocol and grading standards with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to look up how a defect is scored.
